title: EduQG: A Multi-format Multiple Choice Dataset for the Educational Domain
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on generating multiple-choice questions from general educational texts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
